talents.e: Boosts Smite and Penance damage against targets your Holy Fire is burning.
Raises your damage with wands.
Boosts damage and healing of your instant cast spells.
Cuts Holy spell threat and shortens stuns, fears, and silences on you.
Raises your hit chance with Holy spells.
Increases your total Intellect.
Critical hits taken can grant Focused Casting, helping you resist interrupts.
Lowers mana cost of Smite, Holy Fire, and instant spells.
Makes your next spell free of mana and raises its crit chance.
Makes your Power Word: Shield absorb more damage.
Lets a share of your mana regeneration continue while casting.
Boosts Inner Fire's armor bonus and adds more charges.
Shortens the cast time of Mana Burn.
Shortens Power Word: Shield's cooldown and reduces its mana cost.
Fires a short volley of holy light that heals allies or damages enemies.
Boosts crit chance of heals on Weakened Soul targets and shortens that debuff.
Critical heals grant the target a short-lived absorb shield.
Boosts the target's spell damage and healing for 15 seconds.
Gives a chance to avoid cast interruption from damage.
Increases the healing from your Renew.
Raises the crit chance of your Holy spells.
Reduces all spell damage you take.
Shortens the cast time of Smite, Holy Fire, and two heal spells.
Blasts nearby enemies with Holy damage and heals nearby allies.
Heals you over time after heavy hits, with a larger share at max rank.
Non-periodic critical heals grant the target bonus armor.
Extends range of Smite and Holy Fire and radius of group spells.
Lowers mana cost of several heals and Penance.
Raises Holy damage and sometimes makes Holy Nova cost no mana.
Heals a target and you for a shared amount.
Gain mana when you cast a heal that differs from your previous heal.
Become a healing spirit for longer after you die.
Adds spell healing and some spell damage based on your Spirit.
Increases the amount healed by your spells.
Places a heal on an ally that bounces to nearby allies when triggered.
Raises your hit chance with Shadow spells.
Gives Shadow damage spells a chance to stun the target.
Chance to boost Spirit after kills, with mana regen while casting.
Shortens the cooldown of Mind Blast.
Lengthens the duration of Shadow Word: Pain.
Extends the range of your offensive Shadow spells.
Shortens the cooldown of Psychic Scream.
Channels Shadow damage over time and slows the target.
Each Mind Flay damage tick hits harder than the previous one.
Mind Blast or a full Mind Flay boosts Spirit for you and your party.
Party members heal from a share of your Shadow damage on the target.
Shadow damage spells stack a bonus to your Shadow damage.
Silences the target and interrupts their casting.
Cheapens Devouring Plague and spreads it when targets die.
Raises Shadow Word: Death crit chance against low-health targets.
Increases your Shadow damage done.
Boosts Shadow damage and cuts Shadow spell mana costs, but blocks healing spells.
